newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds attract light trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds attract light trade.

text.p: UK meals and feeds traders reported light trading on Tuesday across the market.
In the resale market A.D.M. rapemeal traded at 129 stg for spot while Indonesian/Malaysian palmkernel meal fetched 76 stg ex-store Avonmouth.
Screened corn gluten traded ex-store Portbury at 114 stg for spot while in Southampton 126 stg was paid for spot Argentine cottonseed pellets.
High protein soymeal sellers were around one stg down but no business was reported in the middle market.
